subject: Eliminate lines and ticks to left of Y Axis

messages.author: cbf0f6996d577fc2
messages.subject: Eliminate lines and ticks to left of Y Axis
parts: Maybe it's because I can't think of how to describe this that I haven't found a solution yet, but in ggPlot it seems with all but a few of the ggthemes themes I am not able to alter the size of the tick marks and space between labels and the Y axis itself. I would like to adjust this space so there is not the large gap, specifically for barcharts.  I have seen examples of this, but no example code.

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: Eliminate lines and ticks to left of Y Axis
parts: I would take a look at the documentation for `theme` to see if you can use things like `axis.ticks.x/y`, `axis.ticks.length`, `axis.ticks.margin`, and `panel.margin` to get what you want. http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/theme.html
